Supreme Court Orders 7 States to Raise Judicial Retirement Age to 62

The Supreme Court issued directions on September 1 to seven consenting states to amend their service rules and enhance the retirement age of judicial officers to 62 years. The court's order specifically targets states that have agreed to this change, requiring them to formalize it by altering their service regulations. One report noted a request from the 'Puta' association seeking intervention to raise the retirement age from 60 to 65 years.
